summary.intent: Execute all 9 plans of Phase 73 (shared-write-navigation-correctness-web) via wave-based parallel worktree execution to completion, then investigate and fold in remaining scope from a related todo (consolidate-web-shared-navigation-dup) and properly close it out.
summary.outcome: All 9 plans across 3 waves executed, merged, and verified (7/7 SC after one gap fix); phase marked complete as the final phase of milestone v2.0. A follow-up consolidation agent closed 3 of 4 remaining todo sub-items (deduped readSharedContent and ShareDialog helpers, confirmed one item moot) while responsibly backing out of a risky 9-site refactor; the todo was moved to completed with the decision recorded, after recovering from a git mv that initially committed an unmodified blob.

repo: Executor's <worktree_metadata> JSON sometimes reports expected_base as the agent's own post-commit tip rather than the actual fork base — orchestrator must verify against its own captured base via merge-base, not trust the field blindly.

Root pnpm typecheck builds the monorepo dependency chain crypto→core→api-client→sdk-core→sdk (and apps/web via tsc -b) since cross-package types resolve from gitignored dist/, which fresh worktrees lack — executors need explicit pnpm install + build-chain setup notes.

Full monorepo `pnpm test` includes live-API sdk integration tests that false-fail without a running API; post-merge gates should scope to typecheck + the specific changed packages' infra-free unit suites instead.

close_phase_todos only moves todos tagged resolves_phase:N in frontmatter; if the phase's todos were never tagged, auto-close silently moves zero and they get stranded in pending — must be reconciled by hand.
Phase 73 deleted resolveFolderIpnsPrivateKey (73-06), which made the SC6 todo's sub-item #4 (resolveFileIpnsKey mirror dedup) moot with no code change needed.

Deliberate 'byte-for-byte unchanged' comments in code (e.g. downloadSharedFile) signal a prior explicit decision not to touch that path — deduping across it should be treated as crossing a documented decision, not a free win.

git mv followed immediately by commit can stage only the rename of the HEAD blob if prior Edit-tool changes to that file were never `git add`-ed — resulting in a 0-insertion/0-deletion 100%-rename commit that silently drops the edits (must verify diff post-commit, not just exit code).

code.finding: refreshCurrentDepthWriteKey's seedActiveSharedFolder call omitted publishedNode (unlike the other 3 call sites at lines 268/410/540), causing seedSharedFolder to fall back to PLACEHOLDER_PUBLISHED_NODE and unsealNode to throw a GCM decrypt error on WRITE-03 refresh-access retries; fixed by passing getSdkClient().getSharedFolderState(currentShareId)?.publishedNode ?? PLACEHOLDER_PUBLISHED_NODE (commit d3c39c06e).
Existing correct pattern for capturing live publishedNode at descent time (getSdkClient().getSharedFolderState(currentShareId)?.publishedNode) that the SC4 fix mirrored.

workflow: When a wave-execution subagent makes an undeclared file-modification overlap with a sibling plan in the same wave (not listed in either plan's declared files_modified), git's 3-way merge can still succeed cleanly if the changes are non-overlapping lines (e.g. one is comment-only) — but this should be flagged and watched, not assumed safe.
Independently re-verify a sub-verifier agent's specific, checkable claims (e.g. grep/read the exact lines) before acting on gap reports rather than trusting the narrative alone.

When delegating a risky, behavior-neutral refactor to a subagent, give it an explicit back-out clause (abandon if genuine behavior-neutrality can't be preserved) plus a mandatory local e2e gate against a live stack, then independently re-run the same gate rather than trusting the subagent's self-report of test results.

A subagent's final returned message can be a stale 'still waiting on background process' status if it was captured mid-run before the background task finished — always check for a fuller/later completion report or verify state directly rather than treating the first return as final.

For low-ROI, high-risk internal refactors (no user-facing impact, causes only illusory duplication, real regression risk in security-critical code with no CI e2e gate), the correct disposition is to close the todo with the analysis recorded as the resolution, not leave it open inviting a future risky attempt.

friction: Post-merge gate config (build/test commands) was empty, forcing ad hoc scoping decisions each wave to avoid false failures from live-API integration tests and full monorepo test runs.
commit_failed false-negative from the tracking commit helper despite the commit actually landing, requiring manual git log verification.
Inline node-based JSON/status parsing scripts had syntax errors on two separate occasions, requiring re-runs with cleaner output capture.
API connection closed mid-response during the final todo-closing step, leaving work in an ambiguous state that required manual verification of what had actually been committed.
git mv committed a 0-diff rename because prior Edit-tool changes weren't staged, silently dropping the resolution content until caught by inspecting the commit diff.
open_items: Live browser run of the WRITE-03 rotation-ux e2e case (tests/web-e2e/tests/rotation-ux.spec.ts) was never executed against a running stack (deferred by 73-08 due to parallel-worktree port contention); remains a recommended CI/manual confirmation step even though the code path is now verified.

Sub-item #2 of the consolidate-web-shared-navigation-dup todo (unifying ~9-10 resolveKinds-then-project sites across owned and shared navigation planes) was intentionally not implemented — flagged as a family of load-bearing distinct guard behaviors, not true duplication; any future attempt needs explicit sign-off on changing guard semantics.
Milestone v2.0 (Metadata and Sharing Refactor) is fully complete as of Phase 73 but not yet formally archived via /gsd-complete-milestone.
PR for branch feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web has not been opened; all commits remain local/unpushed.
